metadata.description: Imperial German Navy WWI Atlantic Patrol Sectors

zones.name: English Channel & Dover Strait
zones.briefing: High-value troop transports and cross-channel supply ferries, but heavily patrolled by destroyers, Q-ships, and anti-submarine mine nets.

zones.name: The Western Approaches (South of Ireland)
zones.briefing: The primary bottleneck for transatlantic merchant shipping bound for Liverpool and Bristol. Ideal hunting grounds for ocean-going U-boats.

zones.name: North Sea & Scottish Coast
zones.briefing: Patrol the eastern approaches to Scapa Flow and the Firth of Forth. Watch for Royal Navy cruiser squadrons and Scandinavian neutral vessels.

zones.name: Bay of Biscay & Iberian Coast
zones.briefing: Long-range hunting ground intercepting Mediterranean and South Atlantic trade routes. Requires careful diesel fuel management.
